name: Analog xNode 4x4 stereo line I/O (Livewire+/AES67)
source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). Network: two 100BT RJ45 ports, NET 1 (top) takes IEEE 802.3af PoE, used as redundant mirrored ports or as Livewire plus a separate management port. Power: auto-ranging 90-240 VAC 50/60 Hz IEC inlet and/or PoE, 14 W. 216 x 44 x 298 mm (8.5 x 1.72 x 11.75 in); net weight not published (3.2 kg shipping). Two fit side by side in 1RU with the xNode rack-mount kit 2011-00076; surface-mount kit 2011-00077. 4 stereo (8 mono) balanced line inputs and 4 stereo line outputs, also usable as 5.1 plus a stereo mix. Inputs switch between -10 dBV and +4 dBu; outputs reach +24 dBu. The same 4 stereo inputs and 4 stereo outputs appear in parallel on the RJ45 jacks (one stereo pair per jack: pins 1/2 left +/-, 3/6 right +/-, 4 ground) and on the two DB25s (8 balanced channels each, Tascam/AES59 pinout), so wire one or the other. Rear, left to right: DB25 inputs over DB25 outputs, RJ45 inputs 1-4 over outputs 1-4, NET 1 over NET 2, IEC.

source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). name: Mixed Signal xNode mic/line, analog, AES3 and GPIO (Livewire+/AES67)
source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). Network: two 100BT RJ45 ports, NET 1 (top) takes IEEE 802.3af PoE, used as redundant mirrored ports or as Livewire plus a separate management port. Power: auto-ranging 90-240 VAC 50/60 Hz IEC inlet and/or PoE, 14 W. 216 x 44 x 298 mm (8.5 x 1.72 x 11.75 in); net weight not published (3.2 kg shipping). Two fit side by side in 1RU with the xNode rack-mount kit 2011-00076; surface-mount kit 2011-00077. Mixed signal I/O audio / logic node: 1 selectable mic/line input on an XLR-F, analog line inputs and outputs on RJ45 (stereo per jack), 1 AES3 input and 1 AES3 output on RJ45, and 2 GPIO ports on DA-15 (each 5 opto inputs and 5 relay outputs, Axia GPIO pinout). Telos lists 2 dedicated line inputs plus the mic/line input; the rear is labelled Analog Line Inputs 1-3 and Outputs 1-3. Rear, left to right: XLR mic, RJ45 line inputs 1-3 and AES in over line outputs 1-3 and AES out, GPIO 1 over GPIO 2, NET 1 over NET 2, IEC.

name: GPIO xNode 6 logic ports (Livewire+)
source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). Network: two 100BT RJ45 ports, NET 1 (top) takes IEEE 802.3af PoE, used as redundant mirrored ports or as Livewire plus a separate management port. Power: auto-ranging 90-240 VAC 50/60 Hz IEC inlet and/or PoE, 14 W. 216 x 44 x 298 mm (8.5 x 1.72 x 11.75 in); net weight not published (3.2 kg shipping). Two fit side by side in 1RU with the xNode rack-mount kit 2011-00076; surface-mount kit 2011-00077. 6 GPIO ports on DA-15 female, each with 5 opto-isolated inputs and 5 solid state relay outputs, plus +5 V and ground (100 mA combined per port; external logic supply up to 48 VDC, GPO up to 24 V). notes: Rack ears (one short, one long) and a spacer that join two half-rack xNodes side by side in 1RU, or mount one xNode with the long ear filling the other half. Add each xNode as its own device.
